proposals.claim: Binding of RON2 to the hydrophobic groove of AMA1 triggers junction formation between the apical end of the merozoite and the RBC surface to initiate invasion
proposals.quote: An essential step in the invasion of red blood cells (RBCs) by Plasmodium falciparum (Pf) merozoites is the binding of rhoptry neck protein 2 (RON2) to the hydrophobic groove of apical membrane antigen 1 (AMA1), triggering junction formation between the apical end of the merozoite and the RBC surface to initiate invasion.

proposals.claim: Vaccination with AMA1 provided protection against homologous parasites in one of two phase 2 clinical trials
proposals.quote: Vaccination with AMA1 provided protection against homologous parasites in one of two phase 2 clinical trials; however, despite its ability to induce high-titer invasion-blocking antibodies in a controlled human challenge trial, the vaccine conferred little protection even against the homologous parasite.

proposals.claim: AMA1 vaccine conferred little protection even against the homologous parasite despite inducing high-titer invasion-blocking antibodies in a controlled human challenge trial
proposals.quote: Vaccination with AMA1 provided protection against homologous parasites in one of two phase 2 clinical trials; however, despite its ability to induce high-titer invasion-blocking antibodies in a controlled human challenge trial, the vaccine conferred little protection even against the homologous parasite.

proposals.claim: Immunization with an AMA1-RON2 peptide complex provided complete protection against a lethal Plasmodium yoelii challenge in mice
proposals.quote: Here we provide evidence that immunization with an AMA1-RON2 peptide complex, but not with AMA1 alone, provided complete protection against a lethal Plasmodium yoelii challenge in mice.

proposals.claim: Immunization with AMA1 alone did not provide complete protection against a lethal Plasmodium yoelii challenge in mice
proposals.quote: Here we provide evidence that immunization with an AMA1-RON2 peptide complex, but not with AMA1 alone, provided complete protection against a lethal Plasmodium yoelii challenge in mice.

proposals.claim: IgG from mice immunized with the AMA1-RON2 complex transferred protection
proposals.quote: Significantly, IgG from mice immunized with the complex transferred protection.

proposals.claim: IgG from PfAMA1-RON2-immunized animals showed enhanced invasion inhibition compared with IgG elicited by AMA1 alone
proposals.quote: Furthermore, IgG from PfAMA1-RON2-immunized animals showed enhanced invasion inhibition compared with IgG elicited by AMA1 alone.

proposals.claim: The qualitative increase in inhibitory activity is related to a switch in the proportion of IgG specific for certain loop regions in AMA1 surrounding the RON2 binding site
proposals.quote: Interestingly, this qualitative increase in inhibitory activity appears to be related, at least in part, to a switch in the proportion of IgG specific for certain loop regions in AMA1 surrounding the binding site of RON2.

proposals.claim: longitudinal study with 1 year follow-up

proposals.quote: Entry into the host cell requires the apical membrane antigen 1 (AMA-1), a type I transmembrane protein located in the micronemes of the merozoite.

proposals.claim: AMA-1 has an essential role in erythrocyte invasion
proposals.quote: Functional analysis of the leading malaria vaccine candidate AMA-1 reveals an essential role for the cytoplasmic domain in the invasion process. … Entry into the host cell requires the apical membrane antigen 1 (AMA-1), a type I transmembrane protein located in the micronemes of the merozoite.

proposals.claim: AMA-1 functions during the primary contact period upstream of entry around the time of moving junction formation
proposals.quote: This data reveals a crucial function of AMA-1 during the primary contact period upstream of the entry process at around the time of moving junction formation.

proposals.claim: The cytoplasmic domain of AMA-1 is not required for correct trafficking and surface translocation
proposals.quote: Using the complementation assay, we show that the cytoplasmic domain of AMA-1 is not required for correct trafficking and surface translocation but is essential for AMA-1 function.

proposals.claim: The cytoplasmic domain of AMA-1 is essential for AMA-1 function
proposals.quote: Functional analysis of the leading malaria vaccine candidate AMA-1 reveals an essential role for the cytoplasmic domain in the invasion process. … Using the complementation assay, we show that the cytoplasmic domain of AMA-1 is not required for correct trafficking and surface translocation but is essential for AMA-1 function.

proposals.claim: The function of the AMA-1 cytoplasmic domain can be mimicked by the highly conserved cytoplasmic domains of P. vivax and P. berghei
proposals.quote: Although this function can be mimicked by the highly conserved cytoplasmic domains of P. vivax and P. berghei, the exchange with the heterologous domain of the microneme protein EBA-175 or the rhoptry protein Rh2b leads to a loss of function.

proposals.claim: Exchange of the AMA-1 cytoplasmic domain with that of EBA-175 or Rh2b leads to a loss of function
proposals.quote: Although this function can be mimicked by the highly conserved cytoplasmic domains of P. vivax and P. berghei, the exchange with the heterologous domain of the microneme protein EBA-175 or the rhoptry protein Rh2b leads to a loss of function.

proposals.claim: Several residues in the cytoplasmic tail of AMA-1 are essential for AMA-1 function
proposals.quote: We identify several residues in the cytoplasmic tail that are essential for AMA-1 function.

proposals.claim: The cytoplasmic domain of AMA-1 is phosphorylated
proposals.quote: We show that the cytoplasmic domain of AMA-1 is phosphorylated.

proposals.claim: Phosphorylation of the cytoplasmic domain plays an important role in the invasion process
proposals.quote: Mutational analysis suggests an important role for the phosphorylation in the invasion process, which might translate into novel therapeutic strategies.

proposals.claim: AMA-1 inhibitory peptide treatment
proposals.quote: We investigate AMA-1 function using live video microscopy in the absence and presence of an AMA-1 inhibitory peptide.

proposals.claim: Complementation assay based on strain-specific inhibition in P. falciparum expressing GFP-tagged AMA-1
proposals.quote: We generate a Plasmodium falciparum cell line that expresses a functional GFP-tagged AMA-1. … We functionally validate the ectopically expressed AMA-1 by establishing a complementation assay based on strain-specific inhibition.

proposals.claim: chloroquine resistance
proposals.quote: Mutations in the P. falciparum digestive vacuole transmembrane protein PfCRT and evidence for their role in chloroquine resistance. The determinant of verapamil-reversible chloroquine resistance (CQR) in a Plasmodium falciparum genetic cross maps to a 36 kb segment of chromosome 7. This segment harbors a 13-exon gene, pfcrt, having point mutations that associate completely with CQR in parasite lines from Asia, Africa, and South America. These data, transfection results, and selection of a CQR line harboring a novel K761 mutation point to a central role for the PfCRT protein in CQR. This transmembrane protein localizes to the parasite digestive vacuole (DV), the site of CQ action, where increased compartment acidification associates with PfCRT point mutations. Mutations in PfCRT may result in altered chloroquine flux or reduced drug binding to hematin through an effect on DV pH.

proposals.claim: At least 53 distinct isoforms of PfCRT are expressed in strains or isolates of P. falciparum from around the globe
proposals.quote: At least 53 distinct isoforms of Plasmodium falciparum chloroquine resistance transporter (PfCRT) protein are expressed in strains or isolates of P. falciparum malarial parasites from around the globe.

proposals.claim: These parasites exhibit a range of sensitivities to chloroquine and other drugs
proposals.quote: These parasites exhibit a range of sensitivities to chloroquine (CQ) and other drugs.

proposals.claim: Mutant PfCRT confers cytostatic CQ resistance by transporting CQ away from its DV target (free heme released upon hemoglobin digestion)
proposals.quote: Mutant PfCRT is believed to confer cytostatic CQ resistance (CQR(CS)) by transporting CQ away from its DV target (free heme released upon hemoglobin digestion).

proposals.claim: Variable CQ transport catalyzed by different PfCRT isoforms is responsible for the range of CQ sensitivities found for P. falciparum
proposals.quote: One theory is that variable CQ transport catalyzed by these different PfCRT isoforms is responsible for the range of CQ sensitivities now found for P. falciparum.

proposals.claim: Additional mutations in drug-selected parasites, or additional functions of PfCRT, might complement PfCRT-mediated CQ transport in conferring the range of observed resistance phenotypes
proposals.quote: Alternatively, additional mutations in drug-selected parasites, or additional functions of PfCRT, might complement PfCRT-mediated CQ transport in conferring the range of observed resistance phenotypes.

proposals.claim: Variable levels of chloroquine resistance likely depend upon either additional PfCRT functions or additional genetic events, including perhaps changes that influence DV membrane potential
proposals.quote: Data show that variable levels of CQR likely depend upon either additional PfCRT functions or additional genetic events, including perhaps changes that influence DV membrane potential.

proposals.claim: The common K76T PfCRT mutation is not, in and of itself, a fully reliable indicator of CQR status
proposals.quote: The data also suggest that the common K76T PfCRT mutation that is often used to distinguish a P. falciparum CQR phenotype is not, in and of itself, a fully reliable indicator of CQR status.

proposals.claim: Heterologous expression in Saccharomyces cerevisiae
proposals.quote: To distinguish between these possibilities, we recently optimized a convenient method for measuring PfCRT-mediated CQ transport, involving heterologous expression in Saccharomyces cerevisiae.

proposals.claim: Quantification of drug transport activity for 45 of 53 naturally occurring PfCRT isoforms
proposals.quote: Here, we use this method to quantify drug transport activity for 45 of 53 of the naturally occurring PfCRT isoforms.

proposals.claim: The K76T mutation in PfCRT is involved in chloroquine resistance in Plasmodium falciparum
proposals.quote: Analysis of gene mutations involved in chloroquine resistance in Plasmodium falciparum parasites isolated from patients in the southwest of Saudi Arabia. … We aimed to examine the molecular basis of chloroquine resistance among Plasmodium falciparum isolates from the southwestern region of Saudi Arabia by analyzing the K76T and N86Y mutations in the PfCRT and PfMDR1 genes, respectively.

proposals.claim: All 95 samples amplified for the PfCRT K76T mutation were undigestible by ApoI
proposals.quote: Of the 121 samples, 95 and 112 samples could be amplified for PfCRT K76T and PfMDR1 N86Y mutations, respectively. All of the samples amplified for the PfCRT K76T mutation were undigestible by ApoI, suggesting the presence of the K76T mutation.

proposals.claim: All isolates exhibited the mutated allele (K76T) at codon 76 of PfCRT
proposals.quote: Surprisingly, all isolates exhibited the mutated allele at codon 76 (K76T) of PfCRT.

proposals.claim: 65 of 109 samples (59.6%) showed the wild-type N86 allele of PfMDR1
proposals.quote: For the PfMDR1 N86Y mutation, 65/109 samples (59.6%) were digestible when treated with ApoI in a pattern, suggestive of the presence of the investigated wild allele (N86).

proposals.claim: 44 of 109 samples (40.4%) carried the mutated Y86 allele of PfMDR1
proposals.quote: However, 44/109 samples (40.4%) were digestible by ApoI, suggesting the presence of the mutated allele (Y) at position 86. … However, the mutated mutant allele at codon 86 (N86Y) of PfMDR1 was found in 40.4% of the samples studied.

proposals.claim: DNA sequencing confirmed the ApoI digestion results
proposals.quote: DNA sequencing confirmed these results.

proposals.claim: This is the first study to investigate the PfMDR1 mutation in Saudi Arabia
proposals.quote: To our knowledge, this is the first study that has investigated the existence of the mutation in the PfMDR1 gene in the country.

proposals.quote: Mutations in the "chloroquine resistance transporter" (PfCRT) are a major determinant of drug resistance in the malaria parasite Plasmodium falciparum.

proposals.claim: Mutant PfCRT transports the antimalarial drug chloroquine away from its target
proposals.quote: We have previously shown that mutant PfCRT transports the antimalarial drug chloroquine away from its target, whereas the wild-type form of PfCRT does not.

proposals.claim: PfCRT behaves as a multidrug resistance carrier

proposals.claim: PfCRT possesses multiple substrate-binding sites
proposals.quote: Moreover, our analyses suggest that PfCRT accepts chloroquine and quinine at distinct but antagonistically interacting sites. proposals.claim: The findings could be exploited to design potent inhibitors of PfCRT

proposals.claim: pfcrt exon 2 haplotype diversity in the Pacific from 1959 to 1979
proposals.quote: Diversity of Plasmodium falciparum chloroquine resistance transporter (pfcrt) exon 2 haplotypes in the Pacific from 1959 to 1979. … Using over 4,500 archival human serum specimens collected from 19 Pacific populations between 1959 and 1979, the period including and just prior to the appearance of chloroquine treatment failure in the Pacific, we PCR-amplified and sequenced a portion of the pfcrt exon 2 from 771 P. falciparum-infected individuals to explore the spatial and temporal variation in falciparum malaria prevalence and the evolution of chloroquine resistance.

proposals.claim: PCR-amplified and sequenced pfcrt exon 2 from 771 P. falciparum-infected individuals
proposals.quote: Using over 4,500 archival human serum specimens collected from 19 Pacific populations between 1959 and 1979, the period including and just prior to the appearance of chloroquine treatment failure in the Pacific, we PCR-amplified and sequenced a portion of the pfcrt exon 2 from 771 P. falciparum-infected individuals to explore the spatial and temporal variation in falciparum malaria prevalence and the evolution of chloroquine resistance.

proposals.claim: Multiple mutations in pfcrt are involved in chloroquine resistance
proposals.quote: Multiple mutations in the Plasmodium falciparum chloroquine resistance transporter (pfcrt) are involved in chloroquine resistance, but the evolution of complex haplotypes is not yet well understood.

proposals.claim: The evolution of complex pfcrt haplotypes is not yet well understood
proposals.quote: Multiple mutations in the Plasmodium falciparum chloroquine resistance transporter (pfcrt) are involved in chloroquine resistance, but the evolution of complex haplotypes is not yet well understood.

proposals.claim: In the Pacific, the prevalence of P. falciparum varied considerably across ecological zones
proposals.quote: In the Pacific, the prevalence of P. falciparum varied considerably across ecological zones.

proposals.claim: On New Guinea, P. falciparum prevalence decreased in coastal high-transmission areas but increased in the highlands during the same period
proposals.quote: On the island of New Guinea, the decreases in prevalence of P. falciparum in coastal, high-transmission areas over time were contrasted by the increase in prevalence during the same period in the highlands, where transmission was intermittent.

proposals.claim: 78 unique pfcrt haplotypes consisting of 34 amino acid substitutions and 28 synonymous mutations were identified
proposals.quote: We found 78 unique pfcrt haplotypes consisting of 34 amino acid substitutions and 28 synonymous mutations.

proposals.claim: The pfcrt N75D and K76T mutations are implicated in chloroquine resistance
proposals.quote: More importantly, two pfcrt mutations (N75D and K76T) implicated in chloroquine resistance were present in parasites from New Hebrides (now Vanuatu) eight years before the first report of treatment failure.

proposals.claim: The pfcrt N75D and K76T mutations were present in parasites from New Hebrides (Vanuatu) eight years before the first report of treatment failure

proposals.claim: There were unexpectedly high levels of genetic diversity in pfcrt exon 2 prior to the historical chloroquine resistance selective sweep, particularly in areas where disease burden was relatively low

proposals.claim: Parasite genetic isolation, host acquired immune status, and genetic resistance to malaria were important contributors to the evolution of chloroquine resistance in P. falciparum in the Pacific

proposals.claim: Plasmodium falciparum resistance to chloroquine is due to point mutations on the pfcrt gene, particularly on codon 76, resulting in an amino acid change from lysine to threonine
proposals.quote: Resistance has been proven to be due to point mutations on the parasite's pfcrt gene, particularly on codon 76, resulting in an amino acid change from lysine to threonine.

proposals.claim: Plasmodium falciparum resistance to chloroquine denied healthcare providers access to a cheap and effective anti-malarial drug
proposals.quote: Plasmodium falciparum resistance to chloroquine (CQ) denied healthcare providers access to a cheap and effective anti-malarial drug.

proposals.claim: The reversal to chloroquine sensitivity is primarily driven by diminished use of chloroquine in the study area in line with the official policy
proposals.quote: This could primarily be driven by diminished use of CQ in the study area in line with the official policy.

proposals.claim: Studies to establish prevalence of the pfcrt 76T gene could be expanded countrywide to establish chloroquine sensitivity status and predict a date when chloroquine may be re-introduced

proposals.claim: in vitro CQ sensitivity testing
proposals.quote: 115 P. falciparum isolates were subjected to in vitro CQ sensitivity testing and PCR-RFLP analysis for the Pfmdr1-N86Y and Pfcrt-K76T mutations. 100 isolates of P. falciparum were found to be resistant to CQ by the in vitro susceptibility test (geometric mean EC50 2.21 µM/L blood) while 15 were found to be CQ sensitive (geometric mean EC50 0.32 µM/L blood).

proposals.claim: in vitro susceptibility to amodiaquine and desethylamodiaquine
proposals.quote: Short report: polymorphisms in the pfcrt and pfmdr1 genes of Plasmodium falciparum and in vitro susceptibility to amodiaquine and desethylamodiaquine. The potential role of polymorphisms in the pfcrt and pfmdr1 genes and in vitro susceptibility to amodiaquine and desethylamodiaquine were explored in 15 chloroquine-resistant Colombian Plasmodium falciparum isolates.

proposals.claim: chloroquine-resistant Colombian Plasmodium falciparum isolates
proposals.quote: The potential role of polymorphisms in the pfcrt and pfmdr1 genes and in vitro susceptibility to amodiaquine and desethylamodiaquine were explored in 15 chloroquine-resistant Colombian Plasmodium falciparum isolates.

proposals.claim: Single nucleotide polymorphisms in the pfcrt gene were seen in isolates with decreased susceptibility to amodiaquine and desethylamodiaquine
proposals.quote: Single nucleotide polymorphisms in the pfcrt gene, including a newly reported mutation (S334N), were seen in isolates with decreased susceptibility to amodiaquine and desethylamodiaquine.

proposals.claim: A newly reported pfcrt mutation (S334N) exists
proposals.quote: Single nucleotide polymorphisms in the pfcrt gene, including a newly reported mutation (S334N), were seen in isolates with decreased susceptibility to amodiaquine and desethylamodiaquine.

proposals.claim: The lowest susceptibility to amodiaquine was observed in an isolate carrying a pfcrt and pfmdr1 Dd2-like haplotype
proposals.quote: The lowest susceptibility found to amodiaquine was observed in an isolate carrying a pfcrt and pfmdr1 Dd2-like haplotype, whereas a pfcrt haplotype related to the 7G8 Brazilian strain was found in a Colombian isolate with the lowest susceptibility to desethylamodiaquine.

proposals.claim: A pfcrt haplotype related to the 7G8 Brazilian strain was found in a Colombian isolate with the lowest susceptibility to desethylamodiaquine
proposals.quote: The lowest susceptibility found to amodiaquine was observed in an isolate carrying a pfcrt and pfmdr1 Dd2-like haplotype, whereas a pfcrt haplotype related to the 7G8 Brazilian strain was found in a Colombian isolate with the lowest susceptibility to desethylamodiaquine.

proposals.claim: Polymorphisms in the pfcrt and pfmdr1 genes play a role in amodiaquine and desethylamodiaquine resistance
proposals.quote: This exploratory study suggests that polymorphisms in the pfcrt and pfmdr1 genes play a role in amodiaquine and desethylamodiaquine resistance and warrants further study.

proposals.claim: PfCRT is the important key of chloroquine resistance (CQR)
proposals.quote: Plasmodium falciparum chloroquine resistance (CQR) transporter protein (PfCRT) is known to be the important key of CQR.

proposals.claim: Mutations in the gene pfcrt are linked to chloroquine resistance in P. falciparum
proposals.quote: Recent studies have definitively demonstrated a link between mutations in the gene pfcrt and resistance to chloroquine in P. falciparum.

proposals.claim: pfcrt mutations are predictive of chloroquine resistance but not quantitatively predictive of the degree of resistance
proposals.quote: Although these mutations are predictive of chloroquine resistance, they are not quantitatively predictive of the degree of resistance.

proposals.claim: Almost all of the characterized parasites carried the previously reported mutations K76T, A220S, Q271E, N326S, I356T and R371I
proposals.quote: Almost all of the parasites characterized carried the previously reported mutations K76T, A220S, Q271E, N326S, I356T and R371I.

proposals.claim: Novel mutations at K76A and E198K were identified on complete sequencing
proposals.quote: On complete sequencing, isolates were identified with novel mutations at K76A and E198K.

proposals.claim: Parasites carrying E198K were less resistant than those that did not carry it
proposals.quote: There was a suggestion that parasites carrying E198K were less resistant than those that did not.

proposals.claim: No relationship between the expression level of pfcrt (or pfmdr1) and response to drug was observed
proposals.quote: No relationship between the expression level of either of these genes and response to drug was observed.

proposals.claim: Other genes must contribute to the degree of resistance once the resistance phenotype is established through mutations in pfcrt
proposals.quote: Data from the present study suggest that other genes must contribute to the degree of resistance once the resistance phenotype is established through mutations in pfcrt.

proposals.claim: in vitro drug resistance of Plasmodium falciparum
proposals.quote: Sequence and gene expression of chloroquine resistance transporter (pfcrt) in the association of in vitro drugs resistance of Plasmodium falciparum. … In this study, a total of 95 recently adapted P. falciparum isolates from Thailand were included in the analysis. Parasites were characterized for their drug susceptibility phenotypes and genotypes with respect to pfcrt.

proposals.claim: drug susceptibility phenotyping and genotyping with respect to pfcrt
proposals.quote: Parasites were characterized for their drug susceptibility phenotypes and genotypes with respect to pfcrt.

proposals.claim: complete pfcrt sequence analysis
proposals.quote: From the original 95 isolates, 20 were selected for complete pfcrt sequence analysis.

proposals.claim: pfcrt and pfmdr1 gene expression measured by real-time PCR
proposals.quote: In addition, pfcrt and pfmdr1 gene expression were investigated by real-time PCR.

proposals.claim: prior to the introduction of artemether-lumefantrine in 2008
proposals.quote: Chloroquine (CQ), alone or in combination with sulphadoxine-pyrimethamine, was widely used for the treatment of Plasmodium falciparum and Plasmodium vivax for several decades in both Vanuatu and Solomon Islands prior to the introduction of artemether-lumefantrine (AL) in 2008. … This study aims to provide baseline data on molecular markers (pfcrt and pfmdr1), along with the origins of pfcrt, prior to the introduction of AL. … Prior to the introduction of AL in the Solomon Islands and Vanuatu, P. falciparum isolates possessed point mutations known to confer CQ resistance and possibly associated with a decreased susceptibility to quinine and halofantrine, but an increased susceptibility to artemisinin and lumefantrine.

proposals.claim: epidemiological surveys conducted on Tanna Island, Tafea Province, Vanuatu and Temotu Province, Solomon Islands in 2008
proposals.quote: Blood spots were obtained from epidemiological surveys conducted on Tanna Island, Tafea Province, Vanuatu and Temotu Province, Solomon Islands in 2008.

proposals.claim: artemether-lumefantrine efficacy study in Malaita Province, Solomon Islands in 2008
proposals.quote: Additional samples from Malaita Province, Solomon Islands were collected as part of an artemether-lumefantrine efficacy study in 2008.

proposals.claim: examination of P. falciparum pfcrt and pfmdr1 genes for polymorphisms
proposals.quote: Plasmodium falciparum pfcrt and pfmdr1 genes were examined for polymorphisms.

proposals.claim: examination of microsatellite markers flanking pfcrt to ascertain origins of CQ resistance
proposals.quote: Microsatellite markers flanking pfcrt were also examined to ascertain origins of CQ resistance.

proposals.claim: 100% of parasites from Tafea Province, Vanuatu and Malaita Province, Solomon Islands carried the K76T polymorphism in pfcrt
proposals.quote: Pfcrt analysis revealed 100% of parasites from Tafea Province, Vanuatu and Malaita Province, Solomon Islands and 98% of parasites from Temotu Province, Solomon Islands carried the K76T polymorphism that confers CQ resistance.

proposals.claim: 98% of parasites from Temotu Province, Solomon Islands carried the K76T polymorphism in pfcrt
proposals.quote: Pfcrt analysis revealed 100% of parasites from Tafea Province, Vanuatu and Malaita Province, Solomon Islands and 98% of parasites from Temotu Province, Solomon Islands carried the K76T polymorphism that confers CQ resistance.

proposals.claim: the K76T polymorphism in pfcrt confers chloroquine resistance
proposals.quote: Pfcrt analysis revealed 100% of parasites from Tafea Province, Vanuatu and Malaita Province, Solomon Islands and 98% of parasites from Temotu Province, Solomon Islands carried the K76T polymorphism that confers CQ resistance.

proposals.claim: comparison of pfcrt allelic patterns and flanking microsatellite markers revealed six haplotypes
proposals.quote: Comparison of pfcrt allelic patterns and microsatellite markers flanking pfcrt revealed six haplotypes with more than 70% of isolates possessing haplotypes very similar to those observed in Papua New Guinea.

proposals.claim: more than 70% of isolates possessed pfcrt haplotypes very similar to those observed in Papua New Guinea
proposals.quote: Comparison of pfcrt allelic patterns and microsatellite markers flanking pfcrt revealed six haplotypes with more than 70% of isolates possessing haplotypes very similar to those observed in Papua New Guinea.

proposals.claim: the dominant pfmdr1 allele across all island groups was YYCND, present in 98.5% of isolates
proposals.quote: The dominant (98.5%) pfmdr1 allele across all island groups was YYCND.

proposals.claim: pfcrt allelic types and flanking microsatellite markers exhibited similarities to those of Papua New Guinea, suggesting the parasites share a common ancestry
proposals.quote: Overall, pfcrt allelic types and the flanking microsatellite markers exhibited similarities to those of Papua New Guinea, suggesting these parasites share a common ancestry.

proposals.claim: Chloroquine clinical failures in P. falciparum malaria are associated with mutant Pfmdr-1, not Pfcrt in Madagascar
proposals.quote: Chloroquine clinical failures in P. falciparum malaria are associated with mutant Pfmdr-1, not Pfcrt in Madagascar.

proposals.claim: mutations in the Plasmodium falciparum chloroquine resistance transporter gene (Pfcrt) play a major role in chloroquine resistance
proposals.quote: Molecular studies have demonstrated that mutations in the Plasmodium falciparum chloroquine resistance transporter gene (Pfcrt) play a major role in chloroquine resistance, while mutations in P. falciparum multidrug resistance gene (Pfmdr-1) act as modulator.

proposals.claim: mutations in P. falciparum multidrug resistance gene (Pfmdr-1) act as modulator
proposals.quote: Molecular studies have demonstrated that mutations in the Plasmodium falciparum chloroquine resistance transporter gene (Pfcrt) play a major role in chloroquine resistance, while mutations in P. falciparum multidrug resistance gene (Pfmdr-1) act as modulator.

proposals.claim: Pfcrt mutant isolates in Madagascar are <1%
proposals.quote: In Madagascar, the high rate of chloroquine treatment failure (44%) appears disconnected from the overall level of in vitro CQ susceptibility (prevalence of CQ-resistant parasites <5%) or Pfcrt mutant isolates (<1%), strongly contrasting with sub-Saharan African countries.

proposals.claim: Except 2 isolates, all samples displayed a wild-type Pfcrt allele without Pfmdr-1 amplification
proposals.quote: Except 2 isolates, all samples displayed a wild-type Pfcrt allele without Pfmdr-1 amplification.

proposals.claim: Chloroquine treatment failures were significantly associated with Pfmdr-1 86Y mutant codon (OR=4.6)
proposals.quote: Chloroquine treatment failures were significantly associated with Pfmdr-1 86Y mutant codon (OR = 4.6).

proposals.claim: in vitro susceptibility to chloroquine was not associated with Pfmdr-1 polymorphisms
proposals.quote: In an independent set of 90 selected isolates, in vitro susceptibility to chloroquine was not associated with Pfmdr-1 polymorphisms.

proposals.claim: Pfmdr-1 mutations occurred on multiple genetic backgrounds
proposals.quote: Analysis of two microsatellites flanking Pfmdr-1 allele showed that mutations occurred on multiple genetic backgrounds.

proposals.claim: Pfmdr-1 polymorphism is associated with late chloroquine clinical failures and unrelated with in vitro susceptibility or Pfcrt genotype
proposals.quote: In Madagascar, Pfmdr-1 polymorphism is associated with late chloroquine clinical failures and unrelated with in vitro susceptibility or Pfcrt genotype.

proposals.claim: chloroquine in vivo efficacy study
proposals.quote: To document the association of Pfmdr-1 alleles with chloroquine resistance in Madagascar, 249 P. falciparum samples collected from patients enrolled in a chloroquine in vivo efficacy study were genotyped in Pfcrt/Pfmdr-1 genes as well as the estimation of the Pfmdr-1 copy number.

proposals.claim: Pfcrt/Pfmdr-1 genotyping and Pfmdr-1 copy number estimation
proposals.quote: To document the association of Pfmdr-1 alleles with chloroquine resistance in Madagascar, 249 P. falciparum samples collected from patients enrolled in a chloroquine in vivo efficacy study were genotyped in Pfcrt/Pfmdr-1 genes as well as the estimation of the Pfmdr-1 copy number.

proposals.claim: in vitro chloroquine susceptibility testing
proposals.quote: In an independent set of 90 selected isolates, in vitro susceptibility to chloroquine was not associated with Pfmdr-1 polymorphisms.

proposals.claim: artemisinin-based treatment
proposals.quote: Association of mutations in the Plasmodium falciparum Kelch13 gene (Pf3D7_1343700) with parasite clearance rates after artemisinin-based treatments-a WWARN individual patient data meta-analysis. Plasmodium falciparum infections with slow parasite clearance following artemisinin-based therapies are widespread in the Greater Mekong Subregion. … To characterize the impact of different pfk13 mutations on parasite clearance, we conducted an individual patient data meta-analysis of the associations between parasite clearance half-life (PC1/2) and pfk13 genotype based on a large set of individual patient records from Asia and Africa.

proposals.claim: parasite clearance half-life (PC1/2) measurement
proposals.quote: To characterize the impact of different pfk13 mutations on parasite clearance, we conducted an individual patient data meta-analysis of the associations between parasite clearance half-life (PC1/2) and pfk13 genotype based on a large set of individual patient records from Asia and Africa. … Associations between the log transformed PC1/2 values and pfk13 genotype were assessed using multivariable regression models with random effects for study site. Both the pfk13 genotypes and the PC1/2 were available from 3250 (95%) patients (n = 3012 from Asia (93%), n = 238 from Africa (7%)). Among Asian isolates, all pfk13 propeller region mutant alleles observed in five or more specific isolates were associated with a 1.5- to 2.7-fold longer geometric mean PC1/2 compared to the PC1/2 of wild type isolates (all p ≤ 0.002).

proposals.claim: Mutations in K13 have been associated with artemisinin resistance in vitro and in field samples from Cambodia
proposals.quote: Mutations in a kelch protein encoded on P. falciparum chromosome 13 (K13) have been associated with resistance in vitro and in field samples from Cambodia.

proposals.claim: The presence of nonreference K13 alleles was associated with prolonged parasite clearance half-life
proposals.quote: The presence of nonreference K13 alleles was associated with prolonged parasite clearance half-life (P = 1.97 × 10(-12)).

proposals.claim: Parasites with a mutation in any of the K13 kelch domains displayed longer parasite clearance half-lives than parasites with wild-type alleles
proposals.quote: Parasites with a mutation in any of the K13 kelch domains displayed longer parasite clearance half-lives than parasites with wild-type alleles.

proposals.claim: K13 mutations arose both through focal emergence and spread and through independent emergence of the same mutation in different geographic areas
proposals.quote: Haplotype analysis revealed both population-specific emergence of mutations and independent emergence of the same mutation in different geographic areas.

proposals.claim: K13 is a major determinant of artemisinin resistance throughout Southeast Asia
proposals.quote: K13 appears to be a major determinant of artemisinin resistance throughout Southeast Asia.

proposals.claim: There was no evidence of resistance moving westward from Cambodia into Myanmar
proposals.quote: While we found some evidence of spreading resistance, there was no evidence of resistance moving westward from Cambodia into Myanmar.

proposals.claim: The emergence of artemisinin-resistant Plasmodium falciparum in Southeast Asia threatens malaria treatment efficacy
proposals.quote: The emergence of artemisinin-resistant Plasmodium falciparum in Southeast Asia threatens malaria treatment efficacy.

proposals.claim: Pfk13 propeller domain mutation frequency surveillance across Africa from 2012 to 2020
proposals.quote: In this review, we provide a summary of Pfk13 resistance associated propeller domain mutation frequencies across Africa from 2012 to 2020, to examine how many other countries have identified these mutations. … The review highlights the frequency of Pfk13 propeller domain mutations across Africa, providing an up-to-date perspective of Pfk13 mutations, and appeals for an urgent and concerted effort to monitoring antimalarial resistance markers in Africa and the efficacy of antimalarials by re-establishing sentinel surveillance systems.

proposals.claim: Artemisinin resistance emerged in South East Asia 13 years ago
proposals.quote: Artemisinin resistance (AR) emerged in South East Asia 13 years ago and the identification of the resistance conferring molecular marker, Plasmodium falciparum Kelch 13 (Pfk13), 7 years ago has provided an invaluable tool for monitoring AR in malaria endemic countries.

proposals.claim: Pfk13 is the molecular marker conferring artemisinin resistance, identified 7 years ago

proposals.claim: Molecular Pfk13 surveillance revealed artemisinin resistance foci in the Greater Mekong Subregion
proposals.quote: Molecular Pfk13 surveillance revealed the resistance foci in the Greater Mekong Subregion, an independent emergence in Guyana, South America, and a low frequency of mutations in Africa.

proposals.claim: There was an independent emergence of Pfk13-associated resistance in Guyana, South America
proposals.quote: Molecular Pfk13 surveillance revealed the resistance foci in the Greater Mekong Subregion, an independent emergence in Guyana, South America, and a low frequency of mutations in Africa.

proposals.claim: Pfk13 resistance-associated mutations are at low frequency in Africa
proposals.quote: Molecular Pfk13 surveillance revealed the resistance foci in the Greater Mekong Subregion, an independent emergence in Guyana, South America, and a low frequency of mutations in Africa.

proposals.claim: The R561H Pfk13 artemisinin resistance-associated mutation was identified in Tanzania, Uganda, and Rwanda
proposals.quote: The recent identification of the R561H Pfk13 AR associated mutation in Tanzania, Uganda and in Rwanda, where it has been associated with delayed parasite clearance, should be a concern for the continent.

proposals.claim: The R561H Pfk13 mutation has been associated with delayed parasite clearance in Rwanda
proposals.quote: The recent identification of the R561H Pfk13 AR associated mutation in Tanzania, Uganda and in Rwanda, where it has been associated with delayed parasite clearance, should be a concern for the continent.

proposals.quote: Only four African countries reported a recent identification of the M476I, P553L, R561H, P574L, C580Y and A675V Pfk13 mutations at low frequencies and with no reports of clinical treatment failure, except for Rwanda.

proposals.claim: These Pfk13 mutations were reported at low frequencies with no reports of clinical treatment failure except for Rwanda
proposals.quote: Only four African countries reported a recent identification of the M476I, P553L, R561H, P574L, C580Y and A675V Pfk13 mutations at low frequencies and with no reports of clinical treatment failure, except for Rwanda.

proposals.claim: These Pfk13 mutations present a threat to malaria control across Africa
